SELECT CASE substr(id, 1, 1) WHEN '1' THEN 'Oxidoreductases' WHEN '2' THEN 'Transferases' WHEN '3' THEN 'Hydrolases' WHEN '4' THEN 'Lyases' WHEN '5' THEN 'Isomerases' WHEN '6' THEN 'Ligases' WHEN '7' THEN 'Translocases' END AS enzyme_class, count(DISTINCT rhea_id) AS reactions FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea2ec GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of registered committees lean Democratic, Republican or neither?
SELECT cmte_pty_affiliation, count(DISTINCT cmte_id) AS committees FROM govblock_fec.committees GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which states had the most health-based drinking water violations beginning in 2024?

SELECT substr(pwsid, 1, 2) AS state, count(DISTINCT violation_id) AS violations FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_violations_enforcement WHERE is_health_based_ind = 'Y' AND substr(non_compl_per_begin_date, 7, 4) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the median home value in Westchester County, New York?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0500000US36119' AND variable = 'B25077_E001'
Which counties had the lowest per capita income in 2024?
SELECT geoname, try_cast(_2024 AS double) AS per_capita_income FROM govblock_economy.bea_cainc1 WHERE linecode = '3' AND geoname LIKE '%, %' AND try_cast(_2024 AS double) > 0 ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10
How many filings in the notes data set came from companies in New York State?
SELECT count(*) AS filings FROM govblock_sec.sec_fsnds_sub WHERE stprba = 'NY'
Which states had the most traffic deaths in 2021?
SELECT statename, sum(try_cast(fatals AS integer)) AS deaths FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2021' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many recall campaigns were opened each year from 2015 to 2024?

SELECT substr(cast(rcdate AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(DISTINCT campno) AS campaigns FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_recalls WHERE substr(cast(rcdate AS varchar), 1, 4) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
What kinds of informal enforcement do regulators use most against water polluters?
SELECT enf_type_desc, count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_informal_enforcement_actions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
In how many counties does the map show at least one substation?
SELECT count(DISTINCT countyfips) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_electric_substations
What share of e-filed nonprofit returns are full 990s, 990-EZs and private foundation 990-PFs?
SELECT return_type, count(*) AS filings FROM govblock_nonprofits.irs_990_index GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which industries release the most carcinogens?
SELECT _23_industry_sector, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE _46_carcinogen = 'YES' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many PubChem compounds have aspirin as their parent compound?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_parent WHERE c1 = '2244'
